status.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/patapsco-valley-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380120 (alert: 'The Hollofield area campground is currently closed for renovations. values.note: Reservable online up to 365 days ahead and at least one day before arrival, or at 1-888-432-2267. The Hollofield campground itself is closed for renovations (2026).

summary: Hollofield campground is closed for renovations (booking-site alert; DNR's fee page still says 3/27 - 11/30/2025): status temporarily_closed added with both statements. Confirmed fees ($18.50 / $24.50 on oc.aspx). Added 30-amp, 71 Hollofield sites to 40 ft, booking 365 days ahead closing one day before arrival. Not stated for Hollofield itself: showers/dump (the booking site lists them park-wide only), minimum stay and walk-ups (left inherited), season.
flags: Status: Hollofield campground 'currently closed for renovations' (parkreservations.maryland.gov alert, read 2026-10-21); DNR's oc.aspx gives 'closed for construction 3/27 - 11/30/2025', now past. Reopening not announced; the booking site's 2027 dates list all campsites from March 26, 2027.

Fees (not overwritten): the booking site's Facility Rates show 'Campsite Non-Electric $19.50-$20.50 / Campsite Electric $25.50-$26.50' for 2026-2027, $1 above DNR's $18.50/$24.50, footnoted 'do not reflect ... surcharges (holiday/weekend/residency)'; the fee note's 'no out-of-state camping surcharge' is unconfirmed (Elk Neck's DNR page states $1/night for non-Maryland residents).
Phone: entry has none; DNR gives 'Contact: 410-461-5005' (https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/central/patapsco.aspx).
Website: the entry's website is the booking page only; DNR's park page is https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/central/patapsco.aspx (no separate Hollofield camping page found).
